description: External alterations to south western terrace area to include: erection of 1.8m high glass screenings to eastern, southern and western elevations, erection of 2no retractable seasonal awnings and 1m high fencing within the main terrace area, replacement of the existing gates with new gates to western boundary elevation, associated landscaping and creation of play surface areas.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration 
of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission. 

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country 
Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory 
Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in 
accordance with the materials (including colour and finish) specified on the 
drawings hereby approved. The development shall be permanently retained in 
accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing 
elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the 
works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, 
DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The play surfaces hereby permitted shall be permeable and permanently 
retained and maintained in this form as indicated in the Planning Design Report 
(ref: IFW001-R001-C_External Works) received 14 April 2026.   

To prevent any increased risk of flooding and to ensure the satisfactory storage 
of/disposal of surface water from the site in accordance with London Plan (2021) 
Policies SI 12 and SI 13, and Policies CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the 
details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment contained within 
Planning Heritage Design and Access Statement received 14 April 2026. No part 
of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood prevention and 
mitigation measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details 
and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as 
necessary thereafter.  

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development 
to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan 
(2018).

Condition : 6 - Other than for fire safety drill and emergency purposes, the outdoor space subject to this 
application shall not be used by staff or children attending the nursery other 
than between 8:00am and 6:30pm.

To safeguard the amenities of adjoining properties in terms of noise and disturbance, in accordance with CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
